t: You're looking at a memorial sculpture inside St Dominic's Priory Church in Hampstead. It is a memorial to a soldier killed at Ypres. Joan of Arc is depicted here. She is a patron saint of France, honoured as a defender of the French nation. She played her part in the siege of Orléans and in securing the coronation of Charles the Seventh during the Hundred Years' War. She claimed to be acting under divine guidance, and she became a military leader recognised as a saviour of France.
